home.title: The Intelligence of Things Lab.
home.intro: We study distributed systems, with a focus on IoT, Edge AI, Smart Cities and Industry 4.0. We love turning ideas into working systems—and sharing what we learn so others can build on it.
home.hardwareIntro: Our 30-node IoT testbed is built mainly on Nordic SoCs, with custom NRF-52833 boards and BLE tags. It’s where we put our ideas into practice.
